title: A Zanzibar-style check walks stored relationships until it finds the user
captions: The API asks one question: is Asha a viewer of doc:plan? No stored tuple names Asha as a viewer or editor of the doc. But the schema says viewers of the parent folder are also viewers.
So the check follows the parent tuple, doc:plan#parent@folder:q3. Now the question is: is Asha a viewer of folder:q3?
The folder has a tuple that says members of group:ops are viewers. The check does not list all members. It asks one smaller question: is Asha a member of group:ops?
Yes. The tuple group:ops#member@user:asha exists. Each step was one small lookup. Nested groups and folders just add more steps.
The answer is allowed, and the path explains why. Nobody stored 'Asha may view doc:plan'. Remove her from the group, or move the doc, and the next check says no.
